description: Human/governor-authorized SPIDR dependency leaf of task-45839f34c88d4db291146bd6f2216b99 after fresh HEAD 5fe0fdde reachability proved the combined roster row exceeds the ten-path cap. It adds the six divergence-safe BEFORE/AFTER/RACE cases as a dedicated pre-roster integrity set; the parent master-roster successor is the declared consumer that will advertise and compose this set only after every producer axis lands. Activation uses a proven otherwise-admitted L1 fixture, changing only a 39-character source commit, only a non-pinned 64-hex spec digest, or those divergent left/right legs. Quiesce reaches the real daemon snapshot consumer with all shape, identity, ids, hosts, outcomes, and neighboring facts valid, changing only resolvedCount, only stoppedAt, or divergent count-only versus inventory-host-only legs.

Execute all six cases from integrity-boundaries.security.ts outside the current roster-derived COVERED union until the successor advertises them. Assert denominator=6, exact two-constant and three-arm set equality, zero activation admissions/accepted snapshots, activation codes ACTIVATION_RECORD_SOURCE_COMMIT_INVALID or ACTIVATION_RECORD_SPEC_MISMATCH at GA_ACTIVATION_RECORD, and daemon CUTOVER_GENERATION_QUIESCE_RECORD_ABSENT at DAEMON_CUTOVER_GENERATION with preserved upstream LIVE_QUIESCE_EVIDENCE_COUNT_MISMATCH, STOP_MOMENT_MISSING, or INCOMPLETE at live-quiesce-evidence. Do not edit or soften the expected-red 146-versus-131 master-roster premise.

After exact-path `git status --porcelain` capture, independently mutate the tracked production surface to admit only the 39-character commit, admit only the hostile spec, bypass only the count check, bypass only the stop-moment check, bypass only the host-equality check, and default/drop the daemon upstream refusal. Each mutation must make its named production-surface assertion red; restore each separately and prove tracked bytes with `git diff --exit-code` plus SHA/blob equality. If any persistent production edit is required, stop and re-split to every measured caller rather than widening this row.

Run foreground/unpiped `& {$p='pnpm.exe';function x{&$p @args;if($LASTEXITCODE){exit $LASTEXITCODE}};x exec tsc -p tests/security/tsconfig.json --noEmit;x exec vitest run --config tests/security/vitest.config.ts integrity-boundaries.security.ts;x exec vitest run packages/benchmark/src/activation-record.test.ts packages/core/src/cutover/cutover-quiesce-evidence.test.ts;x --filter @moe/daemon exec vitest run --root . --config package.json src/cutover/cutover-generation-snapshot.test.ts}` and require nonzero Test Files/Tests counts (fresh baselines 1/112 security before six cases, 2/16 units, 1/14 daemon) plus typecheck exit 0. implementationPlan.description: Establish the pre-edit baseline and write the failing contract first. Confirm through current Moe context that both producer dependencies are DONE/merged and that parent task-45839 dependsOn this leaf; capture exact five-path porcelain, file lines/imports, and standalone pre-diff benchmark/core/daemon/security/root failure sets for later path attribution. In `integrity-boundaries.security.ts`, add a roster-independent import and describe block for a not-yet-existing frozen `PRE_ROSTER_INTEGRITY_HOSTILE_CASES`: assert exactly six generated entries, exact constant set `{GA_ACTIVATION_RECORD_LAYER,LIVE_QUIESCE_EVIDENCE_LAYER}`, exactly BEFORE/AFTER/RACE for each, and execute every entry through the shared production-surface refusal/race assertions while additionally requiring zero admissions and the quiesce wrapper/upstream facts. Do not add these entries to `HOSTILE_CASES`, `COVERED`, or the 24-entry roster assertions. Run only the focused integrity file and record a deliberate red caused by the missing export/cases; a red from any pre-existing fence does not satisfy TDD.

Implement the three activation-record entries in the dedicated frozen pre-roster export, calling `composeActivationRecord` rather than reproducing validation. Build one measured positive control that returns `ok:true`, `BINDING_ADMITTED_ACT_PENDING`, rung L1, and a PASS property family: valid human GO_ACTIVATE gate/binding/workRef, four 64-hex generations, exact pinned spec, valid source commit, campaign `{G-L1:'PASS'}`, and a permitted fully populated L1 claim. Derive BEFORE by changing only the top-level source commit to 39 lowercase hex and expect `ACTIVATION_RECORD_SOURCE_COMMIT_INVALID@GA_ACTIVATION_RECORD`; derive AFTER by changing only the first nibble of the pinned spec digest and expect `ACTIVATION_RECORD_SPEC_MISMATCH@GA_ACTIVATION_RECORD`; RACE runs those exact left/right inputs with both tuples pinned. Keep the fixture immutable and ensure loosening either named guard reaches the positive result rather than family, rung, claim, or binding refusal. `activation-record.ts` is read/mutation surface only and receives no persistent edit.

Implement the three live-quiesce entries and finish the dedicated test runner. Construct one otherwise-valid nonempty LIVE evidence record and real `readCutoverGenerationSnapshot` ports with readable JSON, stable nonnegative horizon, valid ProjectActivated/ProjectQuiesced witnesses, and durable import generation so quiesce is the only failing fact. BEFORE changes only `resolvedCount`; AFTER removes only the successful item's `stoppedAt`; RACE uses separate immutable inputs whose left has only the count mismatch and right has only outer-versus-inventory host divergence while ids, shape, outcomes, witnesses, and every neighboring fact remain valid. Pin outer `CUTOVER_GENERATION_QUIESCE_RECORD_ABSENT@DAEMON_CUTOVER_GENERATION`, `missing:'quiesceRecordSha256'`, and exact upstream `LIVE_QUIESCE_EVIDENCE_COUNT_MISMATCH`, `STOP_MOMENT_MISSING`, or `INCOMPLETE` at `live-quiesce-evidence` per leg. Assert neither refusal carries `generations`; both race legs refuse regardless of settlement order. Use the existing 2s race bound and openedStores/root cleanup. Core and daemon production files remain byte-identical.

Perform the single adversarial-review step after implementation. Review null/huge/hostile inputs, immutable fixture reuse, race order/timing, file/store cleanup, exact refusal provenance, and accidental membership in the live roster union. Capture `git status --porcelain` for all five paths and out-of-tree SHA-256 backups before drilling. Independently mutate production to accept the 39-char commit, accept only the hostile spec, bypass only resolved-count, bypass only stop-moment, bypass only host equality, and suppress/default the daemon `upstream`; each run must make the specifically named code/layer or consumer-edge assertion red, not merely fail elsewhere. Separately delete one pre-roster hostile arm and require the exact denominator/arm-set assertion to red. Restore after each drill; in separate calls prove SHA equality to the pre-drill backup, `git diff --exit-code` for the three production files that must equal HEAD, and no leaked temp roots/probe files. A green mutant is a finding and must be fixed or reported, never banked.

Run the one final verification gate in a fresh foreground, unpiped PowerShell process: `& {$p='pnpm.exe';function x{&$p @args;if($LASTEXITCODE){exit $LASTEXITCODE}};x exec tsc -p tests/security/tsconfig.json --noEmit;x exec vitest run --config tests/security/vitest.config.ts integrity-boundaries.security.ts;x exec vitest run packages/benchmark/src/activation-record.test.ts packages/core/src/cutover/cutover-quiesce-evidence.test.ts;x --filter @moe/daemon exec vitest run --root . --config package.json src/cutover/cutover-generation-snapshot.test.ts}`. Require exit 0, security Test Files 1 passed with nonzero Tests including all six new cases, combined unit Test Files 2 passed/Tests >=16, daemon Test Files 1 passed/Tests >=14, and typecheck success. Then run `pnpm.exe --filter @moe/benchmark test`, `pnpm.exe --filter @moe/core test`, `pnpm.exe --filter @moe/daemon test`, `pnpm.exe test:security`, and root-lane-only `pnpm.exe test` as separate foreground legs; compare their HEAD failure paths with the captured pre-diff baseline, require no new failure intersecting the five owned paths, and quote every foreign/pre-existing red verbatim (including the unowned master-roster deficit). Record that no docs changed because no user-visible contract or production bytes changed.

comments.content: Measured out-of-scope production finding during Step 4 adversarial review; this acceptance row does NOT retain the fix. `deriveLiveQuiesceEvidenceDigest` reaches `isJsonValue` before field validation in packages/core/src/cutover/cutover-quiesce-evidence.ts. Repro A: an exact-key evidence object whose `citationKey` is a 20,000-deep nested array throws `RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded` instead of returning the stable fail-closed invalid result. Repro B: an exact-key evidence object with an enumerable throwing getter for `citationKey` propagates the caller-controlled `Error` instead of returning a stable refusal. The daemon reader also performs an unbounded file read/JSON parse before this core validator. I red-tested a local try/catch around the recursive JSON-value walk, but task rail/DoD 4 requires any persistent production edit to be re-split across every measured caller, so I restored the core file byte-for-byte to HEAD SHA256 790D12D9D4595DDF5FCE671137252624AF738A428A2EEADA15AAD495F741B034 and removed the exploratory tests from this row. Architect/governor follow-up is required to measure all callers and own the bounded-read plus total-validation fix; this row remains limited to the planned six acceptance arms.
